name: Vignesh J
title: Software Engineer · Full-Stack & Systems
summary: Software Engineer with 3 years of professional experience designing, building, and scaling modern full-stack web applications and distributed internal platforms. Proven track record architecting high-throughput systems with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS, alongside backend ecosystems in PHP/Laravel, MySQL, and Redis. Built mission-critical tools used daily by 400+ active users across 7 enterprise teams. Experienced in zero-downtime database migrations, API latency reduction (40%+), asynchronous message queues, containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), and AI agent workflows (OpenAI, MCP). Focused on engineering maintainable, observable, and resilient software that accelerates business growth.

bullets: Architected and maintained core full-stack platform services powering CRM, operational tracking, and customer experience for 400+ daily active users across 7 cross-functional teams (CX, Sales, Product, Visa, and Finance).

Engineered AI-assisted call intelligence and workflow pipelines using OpenAI APIs, self-hosted LLMs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool wiring — enabling automated call summarization, sentiment extraction, and automatic CRM pipeline stage transitions without human intervention.
Optimized REST and GraphQL APIs and database queries across high-frequency endpoints, achieving a 40%+ reduction in average response latency and significantly reducing peak server CPU utilization.
Automated financial refund pipelines and CX workflows, cutting customer refund turnaround times from 3–5 business days to under 24 hours while establishing immutable reason logs for audit compliance.
Spearheaded zero-downtime migration of legacy monolithic modules to modern containerized microservices and modern PHP/Laravel & TypeScript services, eliminating operational interruptions.
Introduced Redis caching tiers, connection pooling, and asynchronous worker queues (Horizon & BullMQ), cutting redundant database load by 50% under peak sales traffic.
Implemented comprehensive automated testing suites (Pest, Jest) covering mission-critical payment, booking, and visa allocation logic.
Developed responsive web portals and interactive dashboards using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL for real-time asset telemetry and tracking.
Tuned database queries, index strategies, and API response serialization, resulting in a 30% overall backend throughput improvement.
Hardened application security posture by implementing JWT-based authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), input validation schemas, and AES-256 data encryption for sensitive user records.
Assisted cloud migration and deployment pipelines on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), scaling concurrent system handling capacity by ~50%.
